notes.title: Wand Wars now on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Wand Wars is finally on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] for both Nintendo of America and Europe (includes Australia and New Zealand)! Thank you to everyone for being so encouraging and supporting our game!

Check out Wand Wars on the Nintendo eShop today! 
[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/wand-wars-switch/]https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/wand-wars-switch/[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23369215/b30ea3b3ac500eceff37de76e73dbaf60a8d916a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to the Spellstorm! Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23369215/4767b2160e492f8c6d1f8c65a566e3c4f5b023bd.png[/img]

[h1]A flurry of new content awaits![/h1]
[list]
[*]A brand new single-player campaign
[*]Two new musical tracks
[*]Two new game modes - Spellstorm and Medley
[*]Three new Arenas
[*]New character skins
[*]New spell gem
[*]And a brand new character!
[/list]

Thank you for playing and sharing Wand Wars with your friends!
Happy holidays from the Moonradish crew.

notes.title: Trials Co-op Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23369215/cf71e3b182ce3d6e597c4aea367d698eae5794a6.png[/img]

[h1]The Trials Co-op[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You can now play the Endless Trials with a friend! Up to 2 players.
    [*]Separate 2 player leaderboard
[/list]

[h1]Other fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]FPS is now capped at a reasonable maximum as per community requests (at 150 fps, can be altered in settings.json file)
    [*]Fixed crash related to switching levels and music at the same time
    [*]Frame rate improvements on slower systems (notebooks with Intel GPUs were affected on boss levels)
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update 1.1.0 (The Endless Trials Mode)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23369215/5e424f52cb6dd8b413be1b522b4a22672b6472ad.png[/img]

[h1]THE TRIALS - NEW SINGLE PLAYER MODE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Consecutive arenas with procedurally generated sets of opponents
[*]Bosses with randomized abilities, names and snarky greetings
[*]Variety of new types of opponents
[*]Cooldown based spell cards that let you cast ultimate spells
[*]Perk cards that help in battle or improve your character every trial
[*]Droppable perk cards that give chance on hit and chance on hex cast effects
[*]Ever increasing difficulty
[/list]

[h1]STEAM LEADERBOARDS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ranked by points gained in The Trials
[*]View global and friend rankings
[*]Personal high score available in Steam offline mode
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
[list]
[*]Inventory spell gems now drop when eliminated
[*]Improved ultimate spell casting timings
[*]Bot behaviour improvements
[/list]

[h1]MISC[/h1]
[list]
[*]Character selection screen bug fixes
[*]Updated controller button visuals
[/list]

notes.title: Endless Trials Update (September 27th)
notes.content:
Wand Wars is getting an update in 2 days. The Trials update will bring a new endless mode and will include Steam leaderboard support!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23369215/4e7984af931b081b61869fca0d6e6b9153b73885.png[/img]

You will battle your way through a series of arenas, face acolytes and defeat challenging bosses. Every finished trial will present you with a set of magical cards... choose wisely!

Checkout the update trailer

https://youtu.be/hpc4nO2paJ8

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23369215/2a2bb613f1cb147135622a3dbfa492d12d88b001.png[/img]

notes.title: Build 1.0.1 is live!
notes.content:
Thanks for participating in Wand Wars! Here's what we recently fixed.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Linux menu displaying issues
[*] Windows crashes after splash screen on some dual video card setups when not in DirectX9 mode. If you were experiencing that, you don't need to use DirectX9 mode anymore.
[*] Fixed detection and description of "Jugglenaut" achievement.
[*] Small UI visual bugs.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing and tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Campaign dialogue adjustments
[*] Campaign difficulty balancing
[*] Apprentice campaign level progression changes
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: Trying to resolve availability issue.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're officially released. We are aware there is no way to purchase the game at the moment. We reached out to steam in an attempt to resolve this.

Thanks for your support!
